status: exact positive suffix-energy reduction for the complete joined boundary/future remainder with one open anchored Mobius-energy gate

rows.statement: Retain N=2K+1, q_r=2r-1, the truncated kernel P_(K,R), current coefficients u_i=mu(K+i), future scalars beta and Q, endpoint column p_i=P(i,K), and c=P(K,K) from Corollary 11.22Z.8.
rows.proof_boundary: The range is 1<=R<=K; no Mobius estimate is assumed.

rows.statement: Set A_i=sum_(j=i)^(K-1)u_j and H_R^odd=sum_(r=1)^R 1/q_r.
rows.proof_boundary: A_i is an anchored current-block Mobius suffix.

rows.statement: Put w_0=0, w_i=P(i,K-1) for 1<=i<=K-1, w_K=c, and delta_i=w_i-p_i for 1<=i<K.
rows.proof_boundary: The final value w_K is defined as c, not P(K,K-1).

rows.statement: For 2<=i<=K-2, S_i^bd=S_(i-1)^sh+u_i A_(i+1), with the same formula at i=1 after setting S_0^sh=0.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a finite reindexing of current-current edges.

rows.statement: B_CC-A_CF=sum_(i=1)^(K-2)w_i u_i A_(i+1)+sum_(i=2)^(K-2)delta_i S_(i-1)^sh.
rows.proof_boundary: The boundary and shoulder are joined before the split.

rows.statement: An edge (a,a+g) has joined boundary kernel P(a,K-1)+sum_(i=a+1)^(K-1-g)[P(i,K-1)-P(i,K)].
rows.proof_boundary: The sum is empty when a+g=K-1.

rows.statement: Modewise the edge kernel numerator is phi_r(K-1)phi_r(a)+[phi_r(K-1)-e_r]sum_(i=a+1)^(K-1-g)phi_r(i).
rows.proof_boundary: This is the cancellation-preserving form of B_CC-A_CF.

rows.statement: delta_i=-(pi^2/N^2)sum_(r<=R)phi_r(i)e_r sinc^2(theta_r/2).
rows.proof_boundary: The endpoint jump cancels q_r^2 exactly.

rows.statement: Every consecutive interval I satisfies |sum_(i in I)delta_i|<=8pi H_R^odd/N^2.
rows.proof_boundary: This uses the finite sine-sum formula and no Mobius input.

rows.statement: |sum_(i=2)^(K-2)delta_i S_(i-1)^sh|<pi H_R^odd for |u_i|<=1.
rows.proof_boundary: The proof swaps to current edges before taking absolute values.
Only |mu|<=1 and 0<=b_m<=(4K-m)/(2K) are used.

rows.statement: |beta sum_(i=1)^(K-1)u_i delta_i|<pi^2/2.
rows.proof_boundary: The pointwise delta bound is 4pi^2 R/N^3.

rows.statement: w_i-w_(i-1)>0 for 1<=i<=K, where w_K=c.
rows.proof_boundary: Strict positivity follows from S_R(u)>0 on 0<u<pi.

rows.statement: With C_sin=1/2+2pi, the uniform odd sine-sum bound 0<S_R(u)<=C_sin gives 0<w_i-w_(i-1)<=4pi C_sin/N^2 for every 1<=i<=K.
rows.proof_boundary: The constant is independent of K and R.
Every coefficient is positive, so E_B is nonnegative.

rows.statement: D_B=sum_(i=1)^(K-1)w_i u_i^2+cQ and C_delta=sum_(i=2)^(K-2)delta_i S_(i-1)^sh-beta sum_(i=1)^(K-1)u_i delta_i.
rows.proof_boundary: C_delta retains the endpoint-smoothed shoulder and anchor terms.

rows.statement: sum_i w_i u_i A_(i+1)+beta sum_i w_i u_i=(1/2)[E_B-sum_i w_i u_i^2-c beta^2].
rows.proof_boundary: This is finite suffix Abel summation for the min(w_i,w_j) kernel.

rows.statement: R_B:=B_CC-A_CF+beta gamma+(c/2)(beta^2-Q)=(1/2)(E_B-D_B)+C_delta.
rows.proof_boundary: This is the complete joined boundary/future remainder.
The current part is below pi^2/4 and the future part cQ is below pi^2/6.
The right side is O(1+log R) unconditionally.

rows.statement: R_B=O_epsilon(K^epsilon) for every epsilon>0 if and only if E_B=O_epsilon(K^epsilon) for every epsilon>0.
rows.proof_boundary: Logarithms are absorbed at the all-epsilon subpower scale.

rows.statement: The earlier affine-tent energy is exactly H_K=sum_(i=1)^(K-1)(A_i+beta)^2+beta^2, and E_B<=pi(1/2+2pi)K^(-2)H_K.
rows.proof_boundary: Thus its dyadic criterion dominates E_B, but no Mobius estimate for H_K is proved here.

rows.statement: Together with the inherited Y_(K,r) estimate for O_(CC,int), the E_B subpower estimate controls the complete off-diagonal O_(alpha,K); the prior affine-tent criterion is sufficient for its boundary/future part.
rows.proof_boundary: Both arithmetic estimates remain open.

rows.statement: At alpha=1/2 and K=16,...,1024, direct Mobius audits reproduce R_B=(E_B-D_B)/2+C_delta; at K=1024, E_B=0.097890613, D_B=1.325896381, and C_delta=-0.000050764.
rows.proof_boundary: Finite values prove no asymptotic estimate.

rows.statement: Prove E_B=O_epsilon(K^epsilon) on every dyadic scale for each member of one fixed cofinal positive-alpha sequence.
rows.proof_boundary: This is an anchored weighted Mertens-energy obligation.

rows.statement: The suffix reindexing, positive energy identity, and logarithmic error bound are exact.
rows.proof_boundary: No E_B estimate, Y projection estimate, reciprocal-tail theorem, RH, PF-infinity, Lambda<=0, or Clay-prize result is proved.

mobius_audit.interpretation: deterministic finite identity checks only; no asymptotic estimate

next_action: Seek a cancellation theorem for the anchored block suffixes A_i+beta under the positive increments w_i-w_(i-1), and couple it to the inherited Y_(K,r) projection without splitting the boundary/shoulder join.
proof_boundary: Exact finite algebra and unconditional logarithmic correction bound only; no anchored Mobius-energy estimate or global Riemann-hypothesis conclusion.
